# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Sorcerer level 5 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Sorcerer
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4 spontaneous spell-burden baseline to level 5
# as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from
# the level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4 fixtures, and the same canonical
# bloodline and bloodline class-skill selections (Arcane, Knowledge [arcana]),
# adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Sorcerer burden surface: no Arcane Bond
# execution, no bloodline arcana, no bonus spells/feats at 3rd+ level, and no
# 5th-level bloodline spell grant (the PF1 CRB Sorcerer class table's level-5
# "Special" column reads "Bloodline spell" — verified independently against
# both d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com — the Arcane bloodline's own 5th-level
# bloodline spell is invisibility, but it is bloodline-specific, not
# flat/identity-shaped, so this fixture grounds no new class feature at level
# 5, mirroring the level-3 "Bloodline power, bloodline spell" precedent), no
# spellbook, no spells known, no spell slots, no spell DCs, and no
# level-6+ progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-sorcerer-level5
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:sorcerer:5
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:17
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline:bloodline:arcane
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline_class_skill:knowledge:arcana
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
